text:
lucy: deploy-bot flagged a spike of 502s in ap-northeast canary after the automated values sync. db.connectionPoolSize jumped to 4000.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary-failure ap-northeast - 5/18 pods failing healthchecks (502) - change: values-sync-2024-07-22

ben: only ap-northeast canary affected. staging/prod clean. graphs show connection queue depth + backend timeouts. suspect pool oversubscribe -> ephemeral socket exhaustion.

nora: Values-sync also bumped a chart revision (chart v2.9.0 -> v2.10.0) plus generated overlay. We should avoid a full rollback now. Proposal: 1) apply a canary-scoped values override to revert connectionPoolSize -> 120, 2) hold promotion, 3) pin chart version for this candidate until we validate.

lucy: agree. ben, can you apply the override and restart the canary? keep the change scoped to the namespace so we don't touch other regions.

ben: running:

```
kubectl -n ap-northeast create configmap myapp-canary-values --from-literal=db.connectionPoolSize=120 -o yaml --dry-run=client | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl -n ap-northeast rollout restart deploy/myapp-canary
```

infra-bot: creating ticket INF-4901; placing promotion hold for rc-2024-07-22-myapp; pin request noted for chart v2.9.0.

nora: i'll update release-notes: "Temporary revert: connectionPoolSize reverted to 120 in ap-northeast canary. Promotion held pending 30m stable health. Values-sync exemption requested for this chart group."

lucy: after 15m, if canary stable, we will 1) remove hold and 2) unpin if there's a safe follow-up patch. if problems persist, we escalate to full rollback of the rc and create a postmortem.

ben: override applied, restart triggered. monitoring for 20m :hourglass: will post counts.

deploy-bot: action -> applied canary override; pinned candidate chart v2.10.0 -> v2.9.0 for next promotion; ticket INF-4901.

lucy: thanks team. keep updates brief.
